# Create a `dataframe`

**R**

``` r

df <- data.frame(
  name = c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"),
  age = c(22, 25, 21, 24, 27, 23),
  gender = c("Male", "Male", "Male", "Female", "Female", "Male"),
  study_hours = c(10, 15, 8, 12, 18, 9),
  marks = c(65, 78, 55, 82, 91, 70)
)

df
```

**Python**

```{python}
import pandas as pd

data = {
    "name": ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"],
    "age": [22, 25, 21, 24, 27, 23],
    "gender": ["Male", "Male", "Male", "Female", "Female", "Male"],
    "study_hours": [10, 15, 8, 12, 18, 9],
    "marks": [65, 78, 55, 82, 91, 70]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)
df
```

# filter

**R**

``` r
df |>
  filter(marks > 70)
```

**Python**

```{python}

df[df["marks"] > 70]
```

# Select columns

**R**

``` r
df <- df |>
  select(name, age, marks)
```

**Python**

```{python}
df[["name", "age", "marks"]]

```

# Mutate

``` r
df |>
  mutate(pass = marks >= 50)
```

```{python}
df["pass"] = df["marks"] >= 50
df
```

# Sort

**R**

``` r
df |>
  arrange(desc(marks))
```

**Python**

```{python}
df.sort_values("marks", ascending=False)
```

# Rename

``` r
df |>
  rename(hours_studied = study_hours)
```

```{python}
df.rename(columns={"study_hours": "hours_studied"})
```

# Combine Operations

**R**

``` r
df |>
  filter(gender == "Female") |>
  select(name, marks) |>
  arrange(desc(marks))
```

**Python**

```{python}
df[df["gender"] == "Female"][["name", "marks"]].sort_values(
    "marks",
    ascending=False
)
```
